Filed from project `tagma`.

The judge reads `apps/tagma/app/.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json` from the working checkout, a generated, ignored file that reflects peer session 01a1841c's uncommitted `svelte.config.js`. It compares that against the commit tree's `kit.tsconfig.json`, and counts every app file as a new crossing on this session's lines. Every session landing anything in this checkout is blocked until the peer copies the regenerated file over. The crossing belongs to the peer's change, or to nobody; it is neither new in this commit's tree nor on its lines.
